schedule.comment: Two-species scripted mixture over REAL frames (cxidb-17 lysozyme q lists, cxidb-45 Proteinase K prok_q.npz): hold-and-blend scenes in the spirit of the v2 generator; frames are consumed in file order within each species and never reused. The planted species per frame is the ground truth the monitor draws as the schedule ribbon; the driver never sees it.
